summary: Deep analysis of nf_2var_existence_characterizable sorry (StaviCompleteness.lean:1865). Evaluated 5 proof strategies: (1) backward of nf_exist_sf with sf_top guard — fails for k>0 because 1-var type of witness x does not determine 2-var type of (x,t); (2) 'good NF' disjunction — fails because property has QD k+1 but char_k provides only depth-k; (3) NF finiteness + definability — circular; (4) reduce to stavi_expressive_completeness — circular; (5) nested temporal formula — viable but requires ~700-1000 lines. The k=0 case is provable (atoms+order determine 2-var NF), but k>0 requires encoding the full quantifier structure as nested Until/Since formulas with recursive correctness proofs. Phase 6C marked BLOCKED. Prior estimate of 150-400 lines revised to 700-1000 lines.
blocking_issues: nf_2var_existence_characterizable (1 sorry at StaviCompleteness.lean:1865): The current formula nf_exist_sf uses sf_top as guard in Until/Since, which captures the 1-var type of the witness x but not the 2-var type of (x,t). At depth k>0, the 2-var NF includes quantifier information about which 3-var NFs are realizable, which depends on ALL three of (y,x,t), not just x. Five proof strategies were evaluated and all found circular, insufficient, or requiring ~700-1000 lines. The viable approach is a nested temporal formula construction that recursively encodes each level of quantifier nesting in the NF as nested Until/Since formulas.
continuation_context: The sorry at line 1865 asks: for each sub_nf : NormalForm sig k 2 and parent atom assignment, there exists a StaviFormula sf such that sf holds at t iff exists x, nf_eval_nf M k 2 (Fin.cons x (fun _ => t)) sub_nf. The viable approach is a NESTED temporal formula: for sub_nf at depth k'+1 = (atoms, quant), build U(witness_type AND quant_constraints, sf_top) where quant_constraints encodes each sub3 : NormalForm sig k' 3 as a nested temporal formula at the witness point x. The recursion terminates at depth 0 (purely atomic). Estimated 700-1000 lines: ~200-300 for formula construction, ~100-200 for forward direction, ~200-400 for backward direction, ~100 for helpers. Key infrastructure available: char_k_correct (IH), nf_eval_unique, nf_characteristic_satisfies, nf_exist_sf_forward (already proved). The game infrastructure (ghr93_strategy_compose, ghr93_game_iff_decomposition) provides an alternative bridge but the connection from ExtendedCarrier/rank_type to NormalForm/nf_eval_nf is not formalized.
